purpose: Source-only grouped diagnostic checklist prepared before article acquisition. No reader questions, answers or generated graph consulted. Not an exhaustive independent gold set.

source.title: NBA Rookie of the Year Odds - Wembanyama the early favorite
source.author: Sam Eggleston

assertions.subject: NBA ROTY
assertions.assertion: Award futures offered before and during the season; current-odds heading has no actual numeric odds in the supplied text.

assertions.subject: Victor Wembanyama
assertions.assertion: Spurs player; Gregg Popovich coaches the Spurs; strong contender, not an awarded winner.

assertions.subject: Wembanyama measurements
assertions.assertion: Height 7 feet 4 inches; wingspan 8 feet.

assertions.subject: Wembanyama outlook
assertions.assertion: Young roster and possible load management; defense and agility assessments are attributed to the article; shooting refinement and adaptation are conditional.

assertions.subject: Scoot Henderson
assertions.assertion: Portland Trail Blazers player, described as Damian Lillard’s successor; Anfernee Simons and Jerami Grant as supporting teammates.

assertions.subject: Henderson history
assertions.assertion: Previous G League Ignite season; strength, agility, defense and popularity expectations are article judgments.

assertions.subject: Chet Holmgren
assertions.assertion: Oklahoma City Thunder player; height 7 feet; contender, not winner.

assertions.subject: Holmgren assessment
assertions.assertion: Defense, wingspan, paint-to-three-point scoring and passing suited to OKC pace; no numeric wingspan or statistics supplied.
